m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md and verify handoff is complete. Handoff has: task (exploration driver + verdict), intent (honest reporting), scope (scripts/ + evidence/ + VERDICT.md), exclusions (no harness changes, no re-pull, no DB writes), evidence (3 JSON reports + VERDICT.md), test mode (inspection-only), stop conditions. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context loaded; handoff complete — task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff complete: task(driver+verdict), intent(honest-null OK), scope(scripts/+evidence/+VERDICT.md), exclusions(no harness mods/no re-pull/no DB writes), test-mode(inspection-only), stop-conditions all present

m1-write-driver.title: Write scripts/run_trajectory_grading_strawman.py
m1-write-driver.imperative: Write the exploration driver that calls runner.run_grading over 3 sessions: 2023 Belgium Q (quali, cached), 2023 Belgium R (race, cached), 2022 Spain R (race, different year, cached). Document session picks + why in the header. Use ~5 drivers per session. Write one JSON per session to .agent-work/issue-446/evidence/ with 'grading' in filename. Tol_sector_s=0.050 (50ms). Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 or sys.stdout.reconfigure if needed.

m2-run-sessions.title: Run strawman driver foreground over 3 sessions
m2-run-sessions.imperative: Run py scripts/run_trajectory_grading_strawman.py from the worktree root. This runs the 3 sessions foreground (never background). If a session errors, diagnose: if it is a harness bug, STOP and raise blocker; if it is a data issue, skip that session and try an alternate cached session (e.g. 2024 Bahrain Q). Log output to a file and also display.

postconditions.statement: 3 JSON report files exist under .agent-work/issue-446/evidence/ with 'grading' in name

m3-verify-reports.title: Verify report schema validity and extract key numbers
m3-verify-reports.imperative: Load each JSON report and verify: schema_version=1.0, anchor_gate block exists (passed, max_residual_s, tol_s, n_laps), covariance_gate block exists (passed, reduced_chi_sq, band, n_samples), cross_residual_diagnostic block exists (per_lap_offset_s, per_lap_arc_residual_m, lap_closure_m, n_laps). Extract and record key numbers for the verdict.

m4-write-verdict.title: Write .agent-work/issue-446/VERDICT.md
m4-write-verdict.imperative: Write the verdict: per-session key numbers (anchor residuals RMS/median/max + pass/fail at 50ms; covariance reduced chi-square + pass/fail; cross-residual per-lap offsets range+stability). Then state the DISCRIMINATION CONCLUSION: does the harness discriminate or is it an honest null at 50ms with co-estimated anchors? Numbers must be traceable to the reports. Do not overclaim.
